reviews.text:
A place for great communication between dogs of all breeds and different personalities. I found it wonderful.
The cleanliness of the place and the organization seemed perfect to me.
A happy experience, for us tutors, but especially for Zoe, a German Shepherd, who is always happy when she arrives there and always returns home safe and sound.
My dog ​​loves this place! They take great care of him.

I trust Vitor completely to take care of Simba. It's clear how much he loves being there, the accommodation is excellent, the location is great, he's always updating us with videos and responding quickly! Thank you for all the professionalism and care for the little creature I love so much!

The daycare is wonderful! My dog ​​Eva used to have difficulty interacting with other dogs; she would lunge and didn't get along well in environments with other animals. Since she started attending daycare, we've seen an incredible transformation: today she's super integrated, sociable, and loves going there! The care and affection that the whole team shows her makes all the difference. You can see how safe, happy, and loved she feels. I can only thank them for the excellent work they do every day!

I highly recommend Dogs Care's work. Excellent space, wonderful service, and they always have videos to follow. I started with just boarding and now we take her to daycare weekly. And whenever I travel, I leave her there; I trust them 100%!
Dog's Care is an excellent daycare. Care and affection are its strong points. My dog, Nico, loves it.

They are excellent. They take great care of the dogs with affection and professionalism. The space is great, spacious and clean, with a covered and an open area. The dogs are in packs and get along well regardless of size or age because they guide this integration with technique and attention. They carry out various leisure activities for the dogs that promote development, health and energy expenditure. Lui loves going to daycare and staying with them.

My Rottweiler stays there twice a week. And she comes back super happy and cheerful. She loves it!

When Wednesday arrives, she wakes me up to take her!
I highly recommend Dogs Care House! It's an amazing place: safe, airy, clean, and with a huge space. Vitor and Kelly are super attentive and have enormous affection for all the dogs. …

The only place where I have the courage to leave my four-legged daughter. She loves the daycare and so do I.
I recommend it without hesitation.
There's no better place than DogsCare. Zeus even gets excited to arrive!!! I'm so happy to leave him there ❤️❤️
